data.title: 塞西莉亚 · 遮阳树荫下抱膝啃食冰镇司康饼的幸福微眯
data.action: 盘腿坐在铺着鹅黄色野餐垫的绿树浓荫下，两只小手捧着一块刚从保鲜盒里拿出来的甜司康饼，鼓起腮帮幸福嚼动
data.location: 紧邻平静蔚蓝海湾的绿草茵茵海滨崖顶松树野餐区
data.lighting: 浓密海松树枝筛落圆形金斑，微风吹动裙角，阳光在浅金色的松针与柔顺金发上镀满温暖蜜意
data.mood: 纯真娇憨、无忧无虑与满溢而出的甜美幸福感
data.description: 海风带走了一切暑气，树荫下的野餐篮散发着烘焙的甜香。塞西莉亚换下了厚重的圣女修道袍，象牙白的泳裙显得格外纯洁温婉。她两只小手宝贝似的捧着劳伦斯亲手烘烤的柠檬司康，两颊像花栗鼠一样塞得满满当当，眯起那双海蓝宝石般的眼睛，含含糊糊地向你撒娇——「唔……劳伦斯做的冰镇司康太好吃了……海风吹得肚子好舒服，等会儿吃饱了，劳伦斯可以陪我在树荫下睡个午觉吗？」
data.promptProse: Sitting cross-legged on a pale yellow picnic blanket beneath shaded coastal pine trees overlooking a calm blue bay, Cecilia wears a modest ivory swimdress trimmed with delicate pale-gold embroidery and a sheer flowing skirt. Cradling a freshly baked lemon scone in both hands, she chews happily with puffed cheeks and squinted blissful eyes beside an open picnic basket. Dappled noon sunlight filters through the pine needles and warms the grassy clifftop.
data.animaCaption: Seated cross-legged on a yellow picnic blanket under coastal pine shade in her gold-trimmed ivory swimdress, Cecilia holds a lemon scone with both hands and chews happily with puffed cheeks. Dappled midday sunlight filters through the pine needles above the blue bay.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a modest ivory cathedral-style swimdress accented with pale gold embroidery, an empire waist, and a sheer flowing chiffon skirt.
